description.TokenAI_before:
Token : Local AI Studio runs compatible Core AI, MLX and GGUF models on your iPhone.

Download or import a complete compatible model, then chat offline. Model inference and saved conversations stay on your device. Downloads connect to Hugging Face; no account or subscription is required for public models.

FEATURES
• Local chat with Core AI, MLX and GGUF engines
• Model library with import, search, pinned downloads, retry and removal
• Image understanding with compatible vision models
• Image creation and short animations from generated frames with a separately downloaded Stable Diffusion 1.5 pack
• Apple on-device dictation, supported downloadable Whisper transcription and spoken replies
• Local conversation history, document import and memory search
• Apple language embeddings and supported GGUF embedding models
• Built-in calculator and memory-search tools with compatible models
• Share text, links and photos into TokenAI with the Share extension
• Optional authenticated local API for basic text/image requests
• Memory, thermal and local diagnostic controls

Requires iOS 27 or later. Models need an initial download or import and enough available storage and memory. Features depend on the loaded model, its license and your device; incomplete or incompatible packs cannot run. Image creation needs substantial memory. Animation uses generated frames rather than a temporal video model.

The local API is off by default, stops in the background and serves clients you authorize. Loopback is the default; optional LAN mode uses HTTP on a trusted private network. Prompts and results supplied through the API are shared with the calling client. Advanced client tool schemas and server-side conversation state are not supported.

AI output may be inaccurate or inappropriate. Review important results before relying on them.
description.OnDeviceMax_source:
OnDevice Max brings a local AI workspace to your iPhone. Download compatible models, choose the right one for your task, and keep your conversations organized in one place.

CHAT AND CREATE
Ask questions, draft writing, review code and explore ideas. Start a new conversation or return to a saved chat, with search and pinned conversations to help you find your work.

VOICE AND VISION
Choose a voice for spoken conversations. Use compatible vision models to work with photos and camera captures in Lens.

YOUR MODEL LIBRARY
Browse available models, download compatible packs, import supported model files and manage the storage they use. Model availability depends on your iPhone and the model's requirements.

IMAGE STUDIO
Create images using supported local image models. Image models are downloaded separately. Optional parental controls let a parent restrict image generation with a PIN.

LOCAL API
Enable the authenticated Local API Server to connect compatible tools on your trusted local network.

LOCAL BY DEFAULT
No OnDevice account is required. Conversations are stored on your device and compatible models run locally. Optional web tools send requests to the provider you configure. Optional iCloud conversation sync uses your private CloudKit database.

Requires iOS 27 or later. Model files are downloaded separately and may require several gigabytes of storage. Available features, model compatibility and generation speed depend on your iPhone's memory, storage and thermal conditions. AI results can be inaccurate; review them before relying on them.

promotionalText.TokenAI_before: Local Core AI, MLX and GGUF chat, vision, voice, memory search and optional image creation. Download compatible models for your iPhone. Requires iOS 27.
promotionalText.OnDeviceMax_source: Make room for local AI. Chat, write, explore images and use voice on your iPhone, with downloadable models and optional network features.

whatsNew.TokenAI_before:
• A refined glass design with light and dark mode across chat, history, settings and onboarding.
• Improved history drawer, chat composer and keyboard layout, with saved drafts and restored reading position.
• Open the camera using the new pull handle or the Camera shortcut in the + menu.
• A local document library with source and page references.
• Clearer tool activity and results, plus improved voice interactions.
• Studio dashboard and Model Lab for model management, diagnostics and performance history.
• Improved memory and thermal management, model switching, cancellation and background recovery.
• More reliable model downloads with recovery after interruptions and file verification.
